# ChatGPT product-scoped plugin

The skill is byte-identical to the existing ChatGPT projection, including the complete Taste Main source. Product metadata excludes Codex skill discovery so its model_instructions_file entry remains separate. This is product filtering, not detection of model_instructions_file support or cloud-only execution. CHATGPT was verified through an isolated plugin installation with Codex 0.163.0-alpha.10.2; cloud ingestion and model behavior remain unverified.
